areas.name: Rootbound Entrance
areas.composition: A winding arrival trail around a root arch, with a sheltered guide and waystone.

areas.name: Fallen Idol Crossing
areas.composition: A diagonal river, broad ruined crossing, and combat staging on the eastern bank.

areas.name: Mosslight Clearing
areas.composition: An open mushroom-lit clearing where two lower routes branch away from the sealed path.

areas.name: Vine-Choked Gate
areas.composition: A narrow root-framed approach to the living vine seal, with a small side clearing.

areas.name: Whispering Hollow
areas.composition: A winding corridor between two groves; casters flank its turns.

areas.name: Overlook Bridge
areas.composition: An aqueduct over deep water with two northern piers and an eastern landing.

areas.name: Shrine of the First Seed
areas.composition: A quiet circular stone courtyard around the First Seed altar.

areas.name: Lantern Grotto
areas.composition: A lantern alcove beside a crescent pool, reached along one tucked-away path.

areas.name: Elder Roots Approach
areas.composition: A bent root valley with a sheltered checkpoint before the crown arena.

areas.name: The Hollow Crown
areas.composition: A broad ruined circular court, with the crown roots framing its northern edge.

areas.name: Lastlight Hamlet
areas.composition: A sheltered hamlet with two timber houses beside a broad communal stone road.

areas.name: The Silent Bell Archive
areas.composition: A ruined bell archive with a stone reading court and a tucked-away memorial.

areas.name: Emberwatch Observatory
areas.composition: An observatory courtyard above the river where a lost ember is preserved.

areas.name: The Drowned Gardens
areas.composition: A flooded garden threaded by narrow stone paths between three planted islands.

areas.name: The Root Cistern
areas.composition: A root cistern with a sheltered central landing beside ancient waterworks.

areas.name: Moonwell Sanctuary
areas.composition: A moonlit well enclosed by a crescent pool, with a quiet outer ring.
